note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes only the soldier, and the alate and worker are not described. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown, fontanelle area paler; nasus as dark as the head, slightly darker at the apex; antennae light brown; pronotum much paler than the head, anterior lobe slightly darker; abdominal tergites light brown with a smoky tinge. Posterior half of the head with 1 pair of setae, apex of the nasus with several long and short setae; margin of the pronotum with a few setae; abdominal tergites with microscopic setae, the last 6 tergites with long setae, sternites with short and long setae. Head capsule broadly pear-shaped, wider than long (length with nasus 1.73–1.85, length without nasus 1.09–1.19, maximum width 1.11–1.24 mm); in lateral view depressed behind the base of the nasus; nasus hump absent. Nasus slightly conical, raised anteriorly. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 the shortest. Mandibles each with a small spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, neither anterior nor posterior margin concave (weakly concave in the author's figure); length 0.24–0.25, width 0.50–0.56 mm.
